notes: Card: ' \ufffd' x10, '\ufffd' x7, 'ид' x3. Probe: Cyrillic 'конфиденциальности' 0.647, Korean byte-splitting loanwords 0.198-0.338; the same Korean sentences rewritten with vocabulary words 0.009-0.051. tok.py confirms 커피/테니스/레스토랑/콘텐츠/스크립트/스폰서 split into fallback bytes while 컴퓨터/서비스/사람들이 are whole tokens, and that 'кандидат' carries an 'ид' piece. Near misses were rewritten before registration because Korean verb endings such as 탑니다 and 줍니다 themselves byte-split, and one Russian near miss contained an 'идент' token; the label is therefore restricted to loanword byte pieces. Residual byte pieces inside native morphemes remain in some near misses and scored 0.009-0.051 at probe.
